newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar sees late sell-off, ends off low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar sees late sell-off, ends off low.

text.p: White sugar futures tumbled in late dealings on Tuesday as a weak raws market compounded earlier pressure from trade selling, market srouces said.
Continued speculative liquidation in New York sparked a surge in bearish sentiment on the London market but bargain-hunters moved in at the lows and steadied the fall, they said.
The benchmark March whites contract closed down $3.60 on the day at $294.00 after hitting a session low of $293.50 and bursting through nearby support at $295.10.
May also took a steep tumble to the same intraday low but recovered slightly to end $3.70 weaker at $294.00, the same as March.
Volume was hefty at a total 2,999 lots.
